hook.name: Claus
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Claus protocol that applies dynamic ETH/USD-based fees and splits them across project revenue, liquidity reserve, burn, FOMO reserve, and NFT reward destinations. Supports privacy-preserving ZK-funded buys via ClausPrivacyBuy and checkpoints market cap predictions after each swap. Deployed as a transparent upgradeable proxy.
